column2: text
You're already on a job for someone else. Finish that first, then come and see me.
Nothing for you right now. Check back once the next salvage run is in.
That's all the work I have for you. Thanks for keeping the runs moving.
Fine, we start over. Come back when you're ready.
Then get back out there.
That didn't go the way either of us wanted. Let's try again.

Hey. You look like you can handle the cold. One of my salvage techs, Ria Baxx, went out to the Lucky Despot's engine spur for a power regulator and hasn't checked in. Go find her and bring that regulator back to me.
I'll find her.
What's out there?
What's the pay?
Where's the engine spur?
Not my problem.
Good. I'll mark the last position she reported. Watch the wreck, the mynocks like the power lines.
Ice mynocks, mostly. They chew on anything that still carries a charge, and that spur still does.
Fifteen hundred credits when I have the regulator in my hands.
Out past the outpost, in the drift field. I'll give you a waypoint once you take the job.
Then stop warming yourself at my heater.
I can't get a fix on her position right now. Come back in a moment.
Still waiting on that regulator.
I lost track of Baxx. Can you reset the job?
Sorry, I'm on it.
Fine. I'll send out a fresh fix. Come back when you're ready.
Then go.
That's the one. Baxx made it back ahead of you, by the way. Here's your fifteen hundred.
Ria Baxx
Find the salvage tech Ria Baxx and collect the power regulator.
Quartermaster Vell
Return the power regulator to Quartermaster Vell at the Scavenger Starport.
Watch out, they're coming off the wreck!
You're from Vell? Take it, the regulator's yours. I'm heading back as soon as my hands thaw.
I don't know you. Talk to Vell if you want work.
The regulator job tells me you can walk the drifts. Here's a harder one. A raider captain called Thane Korro has hit three of my salvage runs this month. Find him and put him down.
Consider it done.
Who is Korro?
What's it pay?
How many are with him?
I don't do killings.
I'll give you his last position. Don't let his crew flank you on the ice.
Used to run with the outpost scavengers until he decided robbing them paid better. Now he takes what my people dig out.
Three thousand credits for Korro. His gear is yours too.
Two, usually. They're good shots with those heavy rifles, so don't stand in the open.
Then I'll find someone who does.
I don't have a fix on Korro right now. Give me a minute.
Korro's still breathing. Get to it.
I lost Korro's trail. Can you reset the job?
Sorry, still working on it.
Fine. I'll get a new fix. Come back when you're ready.
Then go find him.
Korro's done? That's three runs that come home now. Here's your three thousand.
Thane Korro
Kill the raider captain Thane Korro.
Quartermaster Vell
Report Korro's death to Quartermaster Vell at the Scavenger Starport.
Vell sent you? Then Vell gets you back in pieces!
I don't know you. Talk to Vell if you want work.
Last job, and an easy one. A broker named Doro Kett buys what we pull out of the wrecks. Take this salvaged current alternator out to his camp and hand it over.
I'll take it.
Who is Kett?
What's it pay?
Where's his camp?
Find another courier.
Here's the alternator. Keep it dry and don't drop it, the casing is cracked.
A trader who comes out from Corellia for the Despot's parts. Pays well and asks no questions, which suits us.
Two thousand credits once Kett confirms delivery.
He camps out on the drifts, never the same spot twice. I'll give you a waypoint once you take the job.
Then I'll find another courier.
I don't know where Kett has set up today. Come back in a moment.
Kett's still waiting on that alternator.
I can't find Kett. Can you reset the job?
Sorry, on my way.
Fine. I'll find out where he is now. Come back when you're ready.
Then get moving.
Kett sent word. Here's your two thousand, and you've got a standing welcome at this outpost.
Doro Kett
Deliver the salvaged current alternator to the broker Doro Kett.
Quartermaster Vell
Return to Quartermaster Vell at the Scavenger Starport.
From Vell? Let's see it. Cracked casing, but it'll do. Tell Vell the credits are on their way.
You haven't got the alternator on you. Go back to Vell.
Pleasure doing business. Mind the drifts on the way back.
I don't know you. Talk to Vell if you want work.
